text:
Sam: Quick sync proposal for an apples-to-apples serving parity run. Goal: isolate kernel selection + batching heuristics + KV cache behavior so we can compare latency and tail regressions between model variants.
Neha: +1. Please lay out harness steps and validation gates. Tokenizer alignment is critical.
Sam: High-level harness
- replay harness: canonical trace of 1k sessions, normalize decoding params and stop sequences
- synth probes: steady and burst QPS to exercise batching decisions
- tokenizer validation: force canonical HF tokenizer and compare token id sequences
- KV scenarios: cold, warm, mixed reuse
- measurements: p50/p95/p99 latency, tok/s, kernel-switch counts, KV hit ratio, kernel path consistency
Jorge: Note: kernel selection depends on max_seq, prompt length, and runtime heuristics. We should pin max_seq and also run a variable-length sweep to see regressions.
Tia: KV warm vs cold needs explicit warmup requests. Add a deterministic prefix warmup step and label requests with reuse rates.
Sam: Flow for each experiment
1) Init: ensure runtime build + model pinned, env RUNTIME_TRACE unset
2) Tokenizer check: run prompt set through canonical tokenizer; fail if ids differ
3) Cold run: clear KV, run 200 requests to observe cold behavior
4) Warm run: run warmup prefixes then replay, measure hit ratios
5) Mixed run: stochastic reuse per request using trace metadata
Notes: tag each request with trace_id to group by reuse fraction.
Ben: Replay config (use verbatim) for deterministic parity:
```json
{ "replay_trace":"/traces/2026-03-01/1000.json", "decode_params":{"temperature":0.0, "top_p":1.0, "max_new_tokens":64, "seed":12345}, "stop_sequences":["\n\n","<END>"], "tokenizer_version":"hf-tokenizers==0.12.1", "kv_reuse_rates":[0.0,0.5,0.9], "no_stream":true }
```
Neha: Two validation gates: 1) deterministic seeds for sampling, 2) no streaming to avoid network interleaving affecting kernel choices.
Jorge: For kernel tracing enable RUNTIME_TRACE=kernel_choice,kernel_latency,kernel_fallback and sink traces to S3 per trace_id.
Tia: I'll add a KV probe that emits per-request kv_hits and kv_misses metadata; harness will pull that into the summary CSV.
Ben: Example profiler output (short run):
```
[perf] total_tokens=125600, avg_tok_ms=0.74, p95_tok_ms=1.85
[kernel] selected=matmul_fused_v3, fallback_count=2, avg_kernel_ms=0.11
[kv] hit_ratio=0.78, avg_kv_ms=0.036
```
Neha: If fallback_count > 0 mark run as 'kernel-fallback' and exclude from primary parity bucket. Fallbacks change decoding timing and are not apples-to-apples.
Sam: Agreed. Primary comparisons only include runs with identical kernel path percentages > 99%.
Ben: Tokenizer alignment
- Run canonical tokenizer on seed prompts for both model variants (vendor tokenizers allowed for model internals) and assert equality of token ids. If mismatch, fail run.
- Also verify stop-sequence handling by instrumenting stop detection offsets.
Jorge: We previously had an internal newline normalization bug. Add explicit normalize_stop_sequences() in harness that prints mapping when normalization occurs.
Tia: I'll implement the normalize_step and the kv_probe by EOD.
Sam: Metrics to record per run
- median response latency
- p95/p99 response latency
- tokens/sec during decode
- percent of requests that followed identical kernel path
- KV reuse hit ratio
- exact-match rate on a canonical short-output set
Neha: Load profiles
- synth: ramp 0->200 RPS over 2m, plateau 10m, 2x bursts for 30s
- replay: preserve original inter-arrival but also run a 10x-speed replay to force high batching
Ben: Perf-regression guardrails
- if p95 > baseline_p95 * 1.12 -> auto-open perf-review ticket and attach traces
- if kernel_fallback_count > 0 in parity bucket -> manual review
- persist profiler dumps and kernel traces to artifacts for triage
infra-bot: deploy: started job run-1717723344-parity-probe on eng-runtime-ci
Ben: After baseline run our quick profiler shows no kernel fallbacks and avg_tok_ms consistent with baseline.
Sam: Small checklist for runs
- tokenizer ids equal? (Neha)
- decode params pinned & seed set (Ben)
- stop sequences normalized (Tia)
- RUNTIME_TRACE enabled for kernel details and sunk to S3 (Jorge)
- KV probe integrated and logs parsed (Tia)
- run artifacts stored in /artifacts/<jobid>/ (infra-bot)
Action items
- Tia: KV probe + stop-seq normalization (ETA: EOD)
- Jorge: runtime tracing + S3 sink (ETA: tomorrow morning)
- Ben: run baseline + upload profiler dumps (ETA: today)
- Neha: tokenizer alignment checklist & deterministic seed doc (ETA: today)
Sam: I'll collate results and propose a narrow rollout window if parity is confirmed across metrics. Ping here for blockers.
Neha: Will post checklist when done :thumbsup:
Sam: Closing thread for now.
